head: fd79017

reviews.name: phase13-spec-review
reviews.note: Caught the destructive Close Other Tabs race (ids re-read at confirm), sticky keycaps after ⌘-Tab, the workspace menu state that survived the sidebar toggle, and the session name breaking the 260 pt cap.

reviews.name: phase13-ponytail-review
reviews.note: One open panel instead of three Bools, one hover state, one focus helper, one spring constant; rejections were a ForEach id that collides on repeated tab titles and moves forced by the 400-line lint limit.

reviews.name: phase13-e2e-review
reviews.note: Only one to drive it with 22 tabs and a long session: found the full-path tab titles, Close Other Tabs taking >2 s, the untested × path and $HOME cwd, and the missing menu icons; ~7 min GUI lock.

reviews.name: phase13-spec-review-2
reviews.note: Found that the round-1 layout fix hid the session behind a long workspace name, and that a tab closed elsewhere would fail the whole close-others group.

reviews.name: phase13-ponytail-review-2
reviews.note: Small line savings (one refresh path in write); a 3-tuple suggestion conflicts with SwiftLint's large_tuple.

reviews.name: phase13-e2e-review-2
reviews.note: Found an assertion that could not fail, an Esc-cancel test that could not tell cancel from save, and a click racing the × reappearing; read only.

reviews.name: phase13-spec-review-3
reviews.note: A stale comment and one doc line.

reviews.name: phase13-e2e-review-3
reviews.note: Made the selected-tab and Esc checks prove what they claim.

reviews.name: phase13-verifier
reviews.note: Read CI's result: the window-title test assumed zsh while CI's shell is bash; flagged menu icons (an AppKit NSMenu showed none either on macOS 27, so recorded instead) and that the last full run was not green.

notes: The rough screenshot cost one round trip (sidebar open icon too thin). Most GUI runs went to layout bugs SwiftUI hides until run: a background ZStack centering the marker, a measured frame locking its own minimum (⌘ and + pushed off), scrollTo hitting a divider, a TextField in a Button label. The Vercel docs deploy fails all day on the free-tier limit (not phase 13).
